entities.name: Kolbjörn
entities.description: The Elder Druid of Fyndhorn during the Ice Age on Dominaria, who bore the crescent mark of the Elder Druid.

entities.name: Disa
entities.description: Kolbjörn's wife, who fought the undead.

entities.name: Kaysa
entities.description: A ten-year-old ward of Halvor Arenson who bore the mark of the Elder Druid and became Kolbjörn and Disa's adopted daughter.

entities.name: Halvor Arenson
entities.description: The priest of Mikkel, who created a disk of sunlight to destroy the undead.

entities.name: Lucilde Fiksdotter
entities.description: A knight who fought the undead at Mikkel.

entities.name: Klazina Jansdotter
entities.description: A knight who fought the undead at Mikkel.

entities.name: Avram Garrisson
entities.description: A knight of the Order of Stromgald who allied himself with Lim-Dul and became undead.

entities.name: Order of Stromgald
entities.description: A knightly order to which Avram belonged.

entities.name: Lim-Dul
entities.description: A necromancer with whom Avram allied.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A goddess whose song Kolbjörn and Kaysa chanted.

entities.name: Fyndhorn
entities.description: The elven forest where Kolbjörn lived.

entities.name: Mikkel
entities.description: A village where the undead attack took place.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: The land Kolbjörn left to live among the elves.

events.summary: Kolbjörn married Disa and left Kjeldor to live among the elves in Fyndhorn forest.
events.quote: Kolbjörn married Disa and left Kjeldor to live among the elves in Fyndhorn forest

events.summary: Kolbjörn travelled to Mikkel to meet Kaysa and argued with Halvor Arenson over her fate.
events.quote: he traveled to Mikkel to meet ten-year-old Kaysa

events.summary: Avram Garrisson revealed he had allied with Lim-Dul and become undead because he thought Kjeldorans had become unworthy.
events.quote: Avram revealed that he had allied himself with Lim-Dul, becoming undead

events.summary: Undead villagers broke into the church and Lucilde, Klazina, Disa and Halvor fought them.
events.quote: When the hordes of the dead villagers broke into the church

events.summary: Kolbjörn and Kaysa chanted the song of Freyalise, stripping the undead of their unholy life and saving the group.
events.quote: With the magic of the goddess, all the undead were stripped of their unholy life, thus saving the group.

events.summary: Kaysa left with Kolbjörn for Fyndhorn and was raised as the couple's adopted daughter.
events.quote: Kaysa was thereafter raised as the couple's adopted daughter.

relations.quote: Kolbjörn was the Elder Druid of Fyndhorn during the Ice Age on Dominaria
Kaysa was thereafter raised as the couple's adopted daughter.

relations.note: He was a knight of the order.

he had allied himself with Lim-Dul
ward of the village's priest, Halvor Arenson
